key_impacts: Harbor break walls were overtopped and shoreline areas flooded into city streets.
Damage occurred to shoreline homes, cottages, and public/boat docks.
Water intake pumps were impacted by large, rapid water level changes.
Water level fluctuations reached about 0.5 m in the harbor and up to 2 m along nearby coastline.
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; shoreline homes and boat docks were damaged; water intake pumps were impacted by large water level changes.
Water level fluctuations reached 0.5 m at the harbor gauge and up to 2 m along the nearby coastline.
